_about: THE NAMES OF THE BOOKS JAMES IS RENAMING. One record per book: `id` never changes (it is the book's folder under client/public/ebook/ and its cover's file name); `slug`, `title` and `subtitle` are the name in use; `was` lists each earlier name, oldest first. TO RENAME A BOOK: copy its current slug, title and subtitle into `was`, write the new ones, then run `node scripts/sync-book-names.mjs` (it rewrites every page, list, script, redirect and text file that carries the name), `node scripts/build-covers.mjs` and `pnpm run search:index`. `fileTitle` is the title printed inside the PDF and EPUB; while it differs from `title` the cards say the file still carries the earlier name. The files are set from the text in content/books-src/<id>/ by `node scripts/build-book-files.mjs <id> --verify`, which prints `title` in them; after that, set `fileTitle` to the new title and run sync-book-names again. A renamed book's own page always says "Published earlier as ..." from `was`. docs/work/elite/bookshelf.md has the whole procedure.
